faq_plan.q: How do I set up affiliate automation?

plan.angle: The top 10 are tool listicles and creator guides about posting content on autopilot; none shows an affiliate program running. This page shows the four jobs a merchant or publisher repeats every week, each written down to the rule, the number and the person who handles the exception: an application scored against a traffic minimum, a commission held through the refund window and reversed on a refund, a monthly payout run with a $50 minimum, and a weekly check of every affiliate link on a review site. The how-to has the operator write the commission rules first and replay last month's orders before any payout goes out.
tab_stories: Corvelle Tea Company gets an application from the Bracklin Kitchen blog with 42,000 monthly visitors; it clears the 10,000-visitor minimum, so the app approves it, issues a referral link and the code BRACKLIN10, and sends the welcome email, while smaller sites wait for the affiliate manager, Kerensa Pembridge.

Moorcastle Leather credits order #8817 for $240 to Theo Grainger's referral link and holds his $36 commission for the 30-day refund window; the customer returns the bag on day 12, so the app reverses the commission and emails Theo.

On the 1st, Maravel Cycling's app totals approved commissions per affiliate: $412.50 and $186.00 go into a $598.50 payout run for the finance lead, Adaeze Okafor-Vane, to approve, and a $38.00 balance under the $50 minimum rolls into next month.
Every Monday the app checks the 214 affiliate links across Trailcairn Reviews' gear posts, finds 3 that return an error, and sends the editor, Wes Quiller, a Slack message listing each post and link.
